title: Successful User Registration with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully register with a valid email and password meeting all requirements
preconditions: User is on the registration page
Email address is not already registered in the system

test_steps.action: Enter a valid email address (e.g., 'testuser@example.com') in the email field
Enter a valid password (e.g., 'SecurePass123!') that meets all requirements: minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, and one special character
test_steps.expected_result: Password field accepts the input and password strength indicator shows 'Strong'

test_steps.action: Enter the same password in the 'Confirm Password' field
test_steps.expected_result: Confirm password field accepts the input

test_steps.action: Click the 'Register' button

expected_results: User account is created successfully
Success message is displayed: 'Registration successful. Please check your email to verify your account.'
Verification email is sent to the provided email address
User is redirected to a confirmation page or login page

title: Registration Fails with Invalid Email Format
description: Verify that the system rejects registration attempts with invalid email formats
preconditions: User is on the registration page

test_steps.action: Enter an invalid email address (e.g., 'invalid-email') in the email field
Enter a valid password (e.g., 'SecurePass123!') in the password field
Enter the same password in the 'Confirm Password' field
test_steps.expected_result: Confirm password field accepts the input

test_steps.action: Click the 'Register' button

expected_results: Registration is not processed
Error message is displayed: 'Please enter a valid email address'
Email field is highlighted with an error indicator
User remains on the registration page

title: Registration Fails with Weak Password
description: Verify that the system rejects passwords that do not meet complexity requirements
preconditions: User is on the registration page

test_steps.action: Enter a valid email address (e.g., 'testuser@example.com') in the email field
Enter a weak password (e.g., 'password') that does not meet requirements
test_steps.expected_result: Password field accepts the input but password strength indicator shows 'Weak'

test_steps.action: Enter the same password in the 'Confirm Password' field
test_steps.expected_result: Confirm password field accepts the input

test_steps.action: Click the 'Register' button

expected_results: Registration is not processed
Error message is displayed: 'Password must contain at least 8 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character'
Password field is highlighted with an error indicator
User remains on the registration page

title: Registration with Minimum Valid Password Length
description: Verify that the system accepts a password with exactly 8 characters meeting all complexity requirements
preconditions: User is on the registration page

test_steps.action: Enter a valid email address (e.g., 'testuser@example.com') in the email field
Enter a password with exactly 8 characters meeting all requirements (e.g., 'Pass123!') in the password field
Enter the same password in the 'Confirm Password' field
test_steps.expected_result: Confirm password field accepts the input

test_steps.action: Click the 'Register' button

expected_results: User account is created successfully
Success message is displayed
Verification email is sent
System accepts the minimum valid password length

title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a registered user can successfully log in with correct email and password
preconditions: User has a registered account with email 'testuser@example.com' and password 'SecurePass123!'
User is on the login page
User is not currently logged in

test_steps.action: Enter the registered email address 'testuser@example.com' in the email field
Enter the correct password 'SecurePass123!' in the password field
test_steps.expected_result: Password field accepts the input (displayed as masked characters)

test_steps.action: Click the 'Login' button

expected_results: User is authenticated successfully
Session token is created
User is redirected to the dashboard
User's name or email is displayed in the navigation bar
Login timestamp is recorded in the system

title: Login Fails with Invalid Password
description: Verify that the system rejects login attempts with incorrect password
preconditions: User has a registered account with email 'testuser@example.com'
User is on the login page

test_steps.action: Enter the registered email address 'testuser@example.com' in the email field
Enter an incorrect password (e.g., 'WrongPassword123!') in the password field
Click the 'Login' button

expected_results: Authentication fails
Error message is displayed: 'Invalid email or password'
User remains on the login page
Failed login attempt is logged
Failed login counter is incremented for the account

title: Account Lockout After Maximum Failed Login Attempts
description: Verify that the system locks an account after 10 consecutive failed login attempts
preconditions: User has a registered account with email 'testuser@example.com'
Account has 9 failed login attempts already recorded
User is on the login page

test_steps.action: Enter the registered email address 'testuser@example.com' in the email field
Enter an incorrect password in the password field
Click the 'Login' button

expected_results: Authentication fails
Account is locked
Error message is displayed: 'Your account has been locked due to too many failed login attempts. Please contact support or reset your password.'
Account locked flag is set to true in the database
Account lockout event is logged
Subsequent login attempts with correct password are also rejected until account is unlocked
